summary: Future Money Acquisition Corp filed an 8-K announcing that holders of its IPO units may elect to separately trade the underlying ordinary shares and rights, effective May 18, 2026. This is a standard post-IPO separation of components; no acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation is involved. The units trade under FMACU, and the separated shares and rights will trade under FMAC and FMACR. No deal terms, premium, or strategic event are presented. This is a routine notification of unit separation, not a special situation filing.
